newsitem.title: CHINA: China end-Oct rural savings hit 751.6 bln yuan.
newsitem.headline: China end-Oct rural savings hit 751.6 bln yuan.

text.p: Outstanding personal savings in China's rural credit cooperatives reached 751.6 billion yuan at the end of October, the Economic Daily said on Tuesday.
Savings showed a rise of 132 billion yuan from the start of the year, it said, quoting the State Council's Rural Financial Restructuring Coordinating Group.
It was the first time China has released the figures after rural credit cooperatives severed ties with the Agricultural Bank of China this year, the newspaper said.
Total deposits, personal savings plus business deposits, stood at 854.6 billion yuan in China's rural cooperatives at the end of October, it said.
Outstanding loans made by rural credit cooperatives reached 630 billion yuan at the end of October, including 312.7 billion yuan extended to township firms, it reported. ($1 = 8.3 yuan)
